import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long flow, cap;

        Edge(int u, int v, long flow, long cap) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static class MaxFlow {
        int src, dst;
        List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer>[] graph = new ArrayList[7100];
        int[] dist = new int[7100];
        int[] cur = new int[7100];

        MaxFlow() {
            for (int i = 0; i < 7100; ++i) {
                graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        void clear() {
            edges.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < 7100; ++i) {
                graph[i].clear();
            }
        }

        void link(int a, int b, long capacity) {
            edges.add(new Edge(a, b, 0, capacity));
            edges.add(new Edge(b, a, 0, 0));
            graph[a].add(edges.size() - 2);
            graph[b].add(edges.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean buildLevels() {
            Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.push(src);
            dist[src] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int id : graph[u]) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(id);
                    if (dist[e.v] == -1 && e.cap > e.flow) {
                        dist[e.v] = dist[u] + 1;
                        q.add(e.v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[dst] != -1;
        }

        long pushFlow(int u, long bottleneck) {
            if (u == dst || bottleneck == 0) {
                return bottleneck;
            }
            for (int i = cur[u]; i < graph[u].size(); ++i) {
                cur[u] = i;
                int id = graph[u].get(i);
                Edge e = edges.get(id);
                if (dist[e.v] == dist[u] + 1 && e.cap > e.flow) {
                    long pushed = pushFlow(e.v, Math.min(bottleneck, e.cap - e.flow));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long solve() {
            long total = 0;
            while (buildLevels()) {
                Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long pushed = pushFlow(src, Long.MAX_VALUE);
                    if (pushed <= 0) break;
                    total += pushed;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static MaxFlow flow = new MaxFlow();
    static char[][] board1 = new char[14][14];
    static char[][] board2 = new char[14][14];
    static boolean[][] seen = new boolean[14][14];
    static int[][] timeCost = new int[14][14];
    static int sizeN, timeSteps;
    static int[] finalNode = new int[103];

    static int nodeID(int t, int x, int y) {
        return t * sizeN * sizeN + (x - 1) * sizeN + y;
    }

    static void expand(int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 14; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 14; ++j) {
                timeCost[i][j] = 111;
            }
        }

        timeCost[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy, 0});
        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1], d = cur[2];
            if (seen[x][y]) continue;
            seen[x][y] = true;
            timeCost[x][y] = d;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nx = x + dx[i], ny = y + dy[i];
                if (nx < 1 || nx > sizeN || ny < 1 || ny > sizeN || seen[nx][ny] || board1[nx][ny] == 'Y') {
                    continue;
                }
                q.add(new int[]{nx, ny, d + 1});
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        sizeN = sc.nextInt();
        timeSteps = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        for (int i = 1; i <= sizeN; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            board1[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= sizeN; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            board2[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }

        flow.clear();
        flow.src = 0;
        flow.dst = 7100 - 2;

        int startX = 0, startY = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= sizeN; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= sizeN; ++j) {
                if (board1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    startX = i;
                    startY = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= sizeN * sizeN; ++i) {
            finalNode[i] = 7100 - 3 - (sizeN * sizeN - i);
        }

        expand(startX, startY);

        for (int i = 1; i <= sizeN; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= sizeN; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(board1[i][j])) {
                    flow.link(flow.src, nodeID(0, i, j), board1[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(board2[i][j])) {
                    flow.link(finalNode[nodeID(0, i, j)], flow.dst, board2[i][j] - '0');
                }
                flow.link(nodeID(0, i, j), finalNode[nodeID(0, i, j)], Long.MAX_VALUE);
            }
        }

        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
        for (int t = 1; t <= timeSteps; ++t) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= sizeN; ++i) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= sizeN; ++j) {
                    if (board1[i][j] == 'Y' || board1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                        int ni = i + dx[d], nj = j + dy[d];
                        if (ni >= 1 && ni <= sizeN && nj >= 1 && nj <= sizeN &&
                            board1[ni][nj] != 'Y' && board1[ni][nj] != 'Z' &&
                            timeCost[i][j] >= t && timeCost[ni][nj] >= t) {
                            flow.link(nodeID(t - 1, ni, nj), nodeID(t, i, j), Long.MAX_VALUE);
                        }
                    }
                    flow.link(nodeID(t, i, j), finalNode[nodeID(0, i, j)], Long.MAX_VALUE);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(flow.solve());
    }
}
